clarifyQuestion: Is this about paying/due fees, a scholarship, or a refund/receipt issue?

entries.question: When is the semester fee payment deadline?
entries.answer: Semester fees are due by the 15th of the enrolment month shown on your fee portal dashboard. A grace period of 5 days applies before late fees start.

entries.question: Can I pay my fees in instalments?
entries.answer: Instalment plans (2 or 3 parts) can be requested on the fee portal before the deadline. A small processing fee applies to instalment plans.

entries.question: How do I apply for a merit or need-based scholarship?
entries.answer: Scholarship applications open each term on the fee portal under "Financial Aid". You'll need your latest transcript and, for need-based aid, income documents.

entries.question: How do I request a fee refund after withdrawing?
entries.answer: Refund requests go through "Refunds" on the fee portal within 30 days of withdrawal. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 10 working days.

entries.question: I missed the deadline, what's the late fee and can it be waived?
entries.answer: Late fees accrue daily after the grace period. Waivers are considered case-by-case; submit a waiver request with supporting evidence through the fee portal.

entries.question: How do I get a duplicate fee receipt?
entries.answer: Duplicate receipts can be downloaded any time from "Payment History" on the fee portal as a signed PDF.

entries.question: When is hostel fee due and how do I pay it?
entries.answer: Hostel fees follow a separate schedule shown under "Hostel Fees" on the fee portal, payable each semester alongside or after tuition.

entries.question: I need a fee certificate for an education loan, how do I get one?
entries.answer: Request a "Fee Structure Certificate" under Financial Aid on the fee portal; it's issued within 3 working days for bank loan applications.
